python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('pyparsing.core')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'pyparsing/core.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import pyparsing as pp
text=chr(34)+'a'+chr(92)+'n'+'b'+chr(34)
a=pp.QuotedString(chr(34),esc_char=chr(92)).parse_string(text,parse_all=True).as_list()
b=pp.QuotedString(chr(34),esc_char=chr(92),unquote_results=False).parse_string(text,parse_all=True).as_list()
print('quoted_results',a,b)
assert a==['a'+chr(10)+'b'] and b==[text]
